title: New York Knicks
article: Right now when I am writing this on Dec, 13. The Knicks are 15-10 on the standings and on December 15 they are up against Orlando Magic. I personally think the Knicks are better than the Nets because the Nets lost most of their good players. For example, Mikal Bridges was on the Nets last year but he joined the Knicks this year. Jalen Brunson has been on the Knicks for a little while now and he’s doing REALLY well, but sadly the Knicks lost Isaiah Hartenstein and Donte Divincenzo which again is pretty sad. The Knicks also have an amazing player who is known as KAT (Karl Anthony Towns). I am going to be making more sports articles on the Knicks and other teams to keep you guys posted. Yes, this was very short but next time I will talk a little bit more about their background and who’s on the team. Anyways thanks for reading my article.
author: Greyson Geldwert
